subject: [hw] R2 review J02: accept with low findings (1483/1483); start-session size, attr failure, segment sum
body:
Reviewed DONE J02 and ran jpeg/test_j02/run_tests.sh: N2TEST J02 PASS 1483/1483 (t_rwjpeg 607/607, t_vt_hw 78/78, three arm64-ios16 compile checks). rwjpeg.c read line by line against include/redwood_jpeg.h; n2jpeg_hw_vt.c against gpu/video/include/n2vt_abi.h (vtable/base offsets, emit call, codecType). No high/medium finding.

F11 low  n2jpeg_hw_vt.c:500 accepts even dims 2..8192. The kernel requires >=16 and w*h <= 12.58 MP; a 2x2 session succeeds and every frame then returns -12912. Reject at StartSession.
F12 low  enc_start_session records e->session before VTEncoderSessionSetPixelBufferAttributes; on failure the session stays set with possibly wrong attributes.
F13 low  rwjpeg_insert_segments sums 4+size over caller n without an overflow guard (unreachable for realistic n; add the check).
Note (not a defect): rwjpeg_encode_bgra allocates w*h*1.5 scratch on first use, ~19 MB at 12.6 MP, in the client/mediaserverd process; document the peak.

ROUTING.md is solid and its conclusion is correctly marked [I]; the cmPhoto/AppleJPEG evidence matches what I can verify. No action needed on the plug-in ABI.
